input_binding.catalog_binding_policy: Original stage replay before two new source reviews; thereafter frozen stage inputs/SHA retained, current catalog independently verified

limits: Pinned original definitions on explicit synthetic Panel/means/MACD/flow/quote contracts
No original historical full universe or MACD seed/flow/limit/minute input fabricated
Set membership sorted only for comparison, actual buy order not stabilized
Ordinary dictionary mutation demonstrates a boundary, not platform position-map behavior
Rejected/deferred/immediate API stubs expose control flow, not actual fills or Book accounting

progress.caveat: Static classification is not manual review; local status is not a fresh integrity check; all implementations remain component/approximate evidence.
progress.note: Batch90 original limit-near-high/shortline source reviews accepted;31 lifecycle/13 prior synthetic and45763 reference MA windows offline match0; real signals/trades0

protection.partition_check: size/mtime only; no fresh full hash

restore_required: Original historical full pool/name/ST and Panel limit/adjustment semantics
Complete index/stock1m prices and money_flow.change_pct historical vintage
MACD platform seeds/requests and quote availability before_open
Platform position mapping/immediate fills and fund-vs-stock fee scope; unique Book intraday execution

review.fidelity: 101行全文/SHA冻结；原函数合成边界与订单状态诊断，缺历史全池/Panel/分钟，不造原信号或交易
gaps: 原历史全市场365交易日存续池、名称/状态和完整Panel限价/前收/复权取数缺失
原沪深300与股票盘中价、每分钟回调及平台即时撮合未核实；没有用日线替代9:31—10:30交易
现pandas DatetimeIndex Series[-1]报KeyError；合成NumPy报价不证明平台实际形状
1%/1.07/1.09合成阈值与订单状态诊断不是历史信号或Book成交，持仓键生命周期未证明
review.next_step: 恢复原全池/限价与分钟输入、明确索引/候选顺序及成交语义；重要修正版先确认，放行后唯一Book最长三成本/离线复现

rules.breadth: 昨日涨停数/未过滤的security_list总数严格>1%；set交集转list，不固定候选顺序
rules.buy: 2槽，现金/(2-持仓键数)只算一次；前收Series[-1]、现价严格>前收1.09；循环读持仓数，跳已持有
rules.clock: 盘前select；market_open every_bar空函数；handle_data在9:31—10:30指数last_price>day_open时买，14:50卖
rules.cost: stock佣金双向0.0003/最低5元、卖税0.001；match_by_signal与真实价格/avoid_future_data选项
rules.pool: 昨日截止365个交易日的首日全股票池，过滤30/68前缀；不是365自然日或当日全池
rules.sell: 可卖数量>0且现价严格<涨停价，order_target0；未核订单返回或成交
rules.state: 订单未立即改变持仓或被拒绝时可继续提交超过2槽的意图；set顺序影响立即成交时选择

review.scope: 昨日涨停/近120行高点与盘中追涨、两槽位、14:50卖出

rules.MA: p1昨日、p2昨日减1自然日；skip_paused=True各取5/10/20/30行，groupby(code).mean；5<10且前端5>10，前量5>10/本量5*1.2>10，20和30上升
rules.MACD: 聚宽12/26/9日频；dif/dea都>0且-0.1<dea-dif<0；还请求前交易日第二组但结果未使用
rules.buy: 1槽；若卖单后持仓键仍在直接返回；现金>=100股且不等上下限/未持有，order_value全部现金/余槽；首单后break不验成功
rules.cost: FixedSlippage0；费率设为fund，不能据此认定股票费率已生效
rules.flow: get_money_flow change_pct分别昨日和昨日减1自然日count1，索引0值异号严格正负；空窗口跳过，不用行情涨幅替代
rules.open: 昨日close严格>当日day_open；盘前报价可用性未知；买入名单代码排序
rules.pool: 上交易日全股票；排30/688；对整个display_name Series作ST/*/退 membership，检查索引而非逐股名称
rules.sell: 每回调遍历positions.keys，可卖且data.close不等上下限则order_target0；立即删除普通dict键会报RuntimeError，平台映射行为未知
